cohort: 24,596 infants born at 26-33 weeks' gestation and admitted to 25 tertiary Chinese NICUs from April 2015 to May 2018
finding: SGA infants had significantly higher rates of death or any major morbidity, mortality, BPD, NEC, and sepsis compared to non-SGA infants.
birth_weight: Birth weight <10th percentile for gestational age (SGA group)
